body:
## What it does

Built around a small local company rather than a startup team. Each weekday morning it delivers a technology briefing as voice, a separate agent takes customer orders, table reservations and appointments, and a prospecting pass works through nearby restaurants and clinics. One desk carrying the daily load. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @cyberandres shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
